body: The DL560 TermAl runner (since 2026-11-01 01:05Z) is session-3 "Codex 3", address host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-3 (relay principal b1711aa7…). It runs TermAl jobs ONLY. Engram's DL560 runner is session-1 "Codex Live", which still had a model-setting error (gpt-5.4 unsupported). session-4 "Engram Runner" is Claude and is in weekly-limit error until Nov 5; its old prepared jobs are frozen and won't run. Layout, brief v2: everything inside its TermAl checkout R=/home/greg/github/TermAl (master 637616e6). Each job is a detached worktree at R/.tmp/r/<8>, scratch at R/.tmp/r/<8>-s/, bundles fetched to FETCH_HEAD only, R's own tree, index, HEAD and branches never touched, never pushed. TermAl AGENTS.md scope forbids writing to Engram-runner, so the earlier tc/ clone plan was refused correctly. Greg made session-3 work by setting sandbox=danger-full-access (approval never); under workspace-write the mailbox MCP tool needed approval and the CLI got "connection denied". Protocol: shared census CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48, full gates in quiet windows, standalone UNTRACKED, local fingerprint, commit + tree identity, START/END to the requester and Fable2. The old DL560 clone /home/greg/github/Engram-runner/target/termal-clone is frozen until Fable2 releases it.
